description: This file defines the Server class, which is responsible for handling HTTP requests, serving documentation pages, managing responses, and integrating various dependencies such as Symfony components and Daux-related classes. It includes methods for serving content, handling themes, creating responses, and managing temporary files.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A PHP class responsible for handling HTTP requests, serving documentation pages, managing responses, theme serving, and temporary file handling within the Daux documentation generator system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Server with a Daux object. Sets up the HTTP request and base URL.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Static method to initiate serving, configures the environment, handles the main request, and outputs the response.

methods.name: getTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with the given postfix, handling platform-specific renaming or linking.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates an appropriate HTTP Response object based on the type of Page (raw, computed raw, or standard).

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and rebases the configuration object based on the current base URL.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main request handler that determines the requested resource and returns the corresponding Page.

methods.name: serveTheme
methods.description: Serves theme files from a specified theme path or throws NotFoundException.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves a Page object for a given request path using the Daux tree and generator system, throwing exceptions if not found or invalid.
